name: Profile writer persists runtime-only state (absolute path, project_id, full `user` snapshot incl. wallet id) into git-tracked `.codx/profiles/*.profile`
description:
## Finding (software_developer, shift 2, 2026-11-17T17:30Z)

While deciding card `0e8baf9d` (workspace↔builtin profile drift) I had to document *why* the drift exists. It is generated: the application serializes the loaded `Profile` back to `.codx/profiles/<name>/<name>.profile`, and the serializer writes state that only exists at runtime.

Evidence (`.codx/profiles/codx-junior/codx-junior.profile`, +53/−2 vs the builtin):
- `"path": "/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform/.codx/profiles/..."` — an **absolute, machine-specific path**;
- `"user": { ... "wallet": {"wallet_id": "fb08f8aa-…", "created_at": "2026-11-17T15:07:47Z"}, "token": "", "api_key": "", ... }` — a **full user snapshot**;
- `"project_id": "d4e4b4a9-…"`, `"chat_id": ""`, `"guardrails"`, `"effort_name"`, resolved `"effort"`.
- Same on `codx-junior-max` (+67/−4). Both `.md` copies also lost their trailing newline (a writer, not an editor).
- `api/codx/junior/model/profile.py:183,196` documents the behaviour: *"migrated to `actor` on save"* and *"Omitted from the serialized profile when unset, so existing `.codx/profiles` files keep their current bytes"*.

Why it matters
1. These files are **tracked in git**, so a user/wallet snapshot (and the `token`/`api_key` fields, even when empty) lands in the repository and in any diff/PR review. Least-privilege/data-hygiene concern for `ciso`.
2. Any machine-specific `path` makes the file non-portable: a fresh clone on another host rewrites it, producing permanent diff noise.
3. It is the root cause of the byte-equality contract broken in `api/tests/harness/test_harness_profile.py` (card `0e8baf9d` relaxed the assertion deliberately; this card is about removing the cause).

What to do
- When serializing a profile to `.codx/profiles`, **exclude** fields that are resolved at load time and re-derivable: `path`, `project_id`, `chat_id`, `parsed_content`, and the `user` snapshot (or at least the `wallet`/`token`/`api_key` members). `Profile` already has an `exclude_if` mechanism (see the `voice` field) — reuse it.
- Keep a trailing newline when writing the `.profile` and `.md` files (mismatched `\ No newline at end of file` on every save).

Acceptance
- After the app loads and re-saves the two harness profiles: `project_changes(paths=[".codx/profiles"])` shows **no** `path`, `user`, or `project_id` delta, and no "newline at end of file" marker.
- `qa_run_tests(suite="pytest:api", paths=["api/tests/harness/test_harness_profile.py"])` → 5 passed (the sync test must stay green).
- No test skipped/`xfail`ed; do not re-tighten the relaxed assertion from `0e8baf9d` without the writer fix.

## Notes
- Owner: `software_developer` (writer), review from `ciso` for the user-snapshot part.
- Independent of the web module cards; do not bundle.
